nodes.description: Owner address state variable of the Ownable contract; controls privileged access.
Public decimals field of the token interface, read to scale transfer amounts.
Reference to the ERC20 token contract used for transfers and balance queries.
Constructor of Ownable that assigns owner = msg.sender.
Only-owner function that changes the contract owner to newOwner.
Safe multiplication with overflow assertion.
Safe integer division.
Safe subtraction that throws on underflow.
Safe addition that throws on overflow.
Constructor of BatchTransferWallet that stores the token address.
Only-owner function looping over investor/amount arrays and calling token.transfer for each.
Only-owner function that transfers the contract's full token balance to an address.
View function returning this contract's token balance.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner authorization.
External token.transfer call inside the batchTransfer loop; unchecked external interaction.
External token.transfer call inside withdraw; state effects ordered before/after interaction.
External token.balanceOf call used in withdraw and balanceOfContract.
External token.decimals() call used to compute the scaling factor.
Array of recipient addresses supplied to batchTransfer.
Array of token amounts supplied to batchTransfer and mutated in place.
Recipient address parameter of withdraw.

Local scaling factor computed from token.decimals().

edges.reason: owner is assigned directly from untrusted msg.sender in the constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before batchTransfer executes.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before withdraw executes.
owner state variable is read in the onlyOwner check of transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the new owner value into the owner state variable.
Ownable constructor initializes the owner state variable.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner state variable assignment.
_tokenAddress parameter is stored into the token state variable.
BatchTransferWallet constructor sets the token state variable.
token state variable is used for transfers inside batchTransfer.
token state variable is used for transfers and balance queries inside withdraw.
token state variable is used by balanceOfContract to query the balance.
token.decimals state value is read to build the scaling factor in batchTransfer.
decimals value is obtained through the external token.decimals() call.
_investors array is iterated inside batchTransfer.
_tokenAmounts array is read and mutated inside batchTransfer.
batchTransfer calls token.decimals() to compute the scaling factor.
batchTransfer performs an external token.transfer call inside the loop, allowing callback into external token code.
batchTransfer performs a SafeMath mul on each token amount.
decimalsForCalc local scaling factor is used in the batchTransfer loop.
loop counter i controls the batchTransfer iteration.
loop counter i indexes the _investors array.
token.decimals() result flows into the decimalsForCalc local variable.
_address parameter is used as the recipient in withdraw.
withdraw performs an external token.transfer call, allowing re-entry through the token contract.
withdraw queries the contract token balance via an external balanceOf call.
balanceOfContract queries the contract token balance via an external balanceOf call.
balanceOf result is stored in the tokenBalanceOfContract local variable.
tokenBalanceOfContract local variable is used as the amount transferred in withdraw.

normalization_plan.reason: _investors is a parameter consumed only by the batchTransfer loop and is normalized into that function.
_tokenAmounts is a parameter read and mutated only inside batchTransfer.
_address is a parameter used only as the recipient in withdraw.
newOwner is a parameter used only to update the owner in transferOwnership.
_tokenAddress is a parameter used only to set the token in BatchTransferWallet's constructor.
decimalsForCalc is a local variable computed and consumed exclusively in batchTransfer.
i is a loop counter local variable used exclusively in batchTransfer.
tokenBalanceOfContract is a local variable used exclusively in withdraw.
